title: You Can't Compete With Someone Using AI Every Day
description:
Everyone has AI now, but almost nobody uses it every day, and that's the real gap. The truth about how to use AI for business in 2026: it's not about the tool, it's about the daily reps. Stop pasting one email into ChatGPT and calling it done. Pick one AI tool, use it on real work every day, and you'll pull ahead of the people who only open it once a month.



Subscribe for daily, no-fluff AI tips you can actually use.
